stories.title: Iran war live: US bombs Iran, Tehran retaliates on Gulf neighbours
stories.reason: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says it hit Prince Hassan airbase and a US Marine base in Jordan, and Supreme Leader Khamenei has issued his first statement since fighting resumed, warning of 'unforgettable lessons' for Washington.

stories.title: Oil tops $92 a barrel as global bond yields hit their highest since 2008
stories.reason: The 10-year Treasury yield hit its highest level since January 2025 and a gauge of global government debt reached an 18-year high, as Iran-war-driven oil prices revive inflation fears worldwide.

stories.title: FTC and 22 states sue Amazon over alleged $20 billion ad auction price-rigging scheme
stories.reason: Regulators allege Amazon secretly inserted a phantom 'soft reserve' bid to drive up ad auction prices for 1.2 million advertisers since 2019, with costs ultimately passed on to shoppers.

stories.title: Anthropic signs $35 billion cloud deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda for a Texas data center
stories.reason: The deal secures roughly 350 megawatts of Nvidia compute at a Hut 8-developed site to keep pace with surging demand for Claude, after Anthropic ran into a supply crunch earlier this year.

stories.title: EU designates ChatGPT a 'Very Large Online Search Engine,' triggering strict oversight
stories.reason: It's the first time an AI chatbot has been classified this way under the EU's Digital Services Act, forcing OpenAI into systemic risk assessments, audits and regulator data-sharing by late November.

stories.title: Ed Markey defeats Seth Moulton in Massachusetts' Democratic Senate primary
stories.reason: The 80-year-old incumbent's decisive win over a generational-change challenger is an early test of how Democrats will navigate age and leadership questions heading into the midterms.

stories.title: China's factory activity expands at fastest pace in years as exports pick up
stories.reason: The RatingDog manufacturing PMI hit a two-month high of 51.5 with the longest new-order growth streak since 2018, a sign Chinese industry is holding up despite ongoing trade tensions.

stories.title: Nepal's flash floods destroyed dozens of schools, threatening education for thousands of children
stories.reason: With 18 schools destroyed and 20 more damaged on top of 32 washed-out bridges, the disaster's toll is extending well beyond the death count into long-term recovery for tens of thousands of children.
